name: Eden Vale
dialogue: Still here. Static's thinning. That's not good news, that's a storm on the way.
The array's drawing again. I don't know what it's drawing for. I don't think it draws for us.

name: Ferris Voss
role: Fire-control acceptance engineer, last human in the fuse world
dialogue: The archive keeps its own count. It does not require a reader.
An order can be paused, and a pause is not a cancellation. That is the whole Standard.

name: Iaran Bell
role: Tempest maintenance supervisor, the valve-touch hand
dialogue: Shift 36 closed out per procedure. The valve reads per 36; the record is complete.
Nobody swept that floor. It sweeps itself, the way the schedule requires.

name: Selya Saltmarsh
role: Census clerk, the only human with an opinion about the count
dialogue: Persons shall not be counted twice. Persons shall not be counted once. The footnotes do not say which clause won.
The count column is blank, and it has been since Year One, when I ran out of households to sight.

name: Maro Veen
role: The machine's own voice — the census-window tape loop
dialogue: This is the Office of Censuses. The count is open. All persons having custody of persons must present them.
Off-count is a penalty assessed against the holder. This message will repeat.

name: Whisper Cipher
role: The relay network's aggregate readings — univocal, procedural
dialogue: Readings follow. No meaning is assigned by this facility.
The meter is the meter. Access is granted by maintenance, withdrawn by nobody.
